# Taxonomy

Six broad categories plus flexible topics and tags avoid a deep hierarchy. The schema controls categories, topics, formats and approaches. A resource has one primary category and one or more topics; cross-category topics generate additional appearances without duplicating data. Tags are lowercase hyphenated editorial groupings, not a second hierarchy.
